title: COMP-MODEL-AB-DECISION registry contract: row shape, admission, compatKey, uplift, latest, catalog rule, promotion/demotion, measurementDecision
_source: docs/features/COMP-MODEL-AB-DECISION/plan.md ### G1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1) and ### Hub contracts; run records from stage-run-contract.json
_changelog: 2026-10-20 G1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1): first version. registry.json, row, admission predicate, compatKey rule, uplift, promotion evidence, promoteRows/demoteRows arguments, measurementDecision file (review r2 R2-3).

2026-10-20 G1 fix round 1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1): $.semantic[] names the predicates JSON Schema cannot check (joins and arithmetic) with reject codes and a conformance suite ($.semanticCases[]); prior rows get their own shape (as_of, n); empty-sample statistics are null and attemptedRunIds is added beside sourceRunIds; #measurementDecision and #promotion resolve; effort is the catalog enum; worked identities follow the resolver.

2026-10-20 G1 fix round 2 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-1): uplift needs BOTH arms measured (new S8 UPLIFT_ARM_STATE: a non-measured row has uplift null with upliftNullReason SOURCE_NOT_MEASURED, a measured row with null uplift says NO_COMPATIBLE_CHAMPION); latest must be complete (every measured cell has an entry, S6); newest is by parsed instant, not string order (S6); demoteRows nulls the demoted row's uplift and every uplift that names it as champion.

2026-10-22 G4-FU-1 (COMP-STAGE-GRADING-4-FU-1): uplift is bound to its exact samples and champion revision. Every experiment row persists `accuracies` (parallel to sourceRunIds); uplift records championRowId, championSampleRevision and sourceSampleRevision; $.rules.uplift defines deterministic champion selection (same catalogDigest first, newest, rowId); $.rules.snapshot makes a replacement a complete cell snapshot (INCOMPLETE_SNAPSHOT); new S9 UPLIFT_BINDING and S10 SAMPLE_VECTOR. Examples and cases updated.
description: Validate by pointing at one of $defs (examples[].validatesAgainst). Cross-record rules a schema cannot express are in `rules`.

rules.admission: A run is admitted iff outcome.completed === true, no _error, not skipped, metrics.stage.oracleError === null, accuracy numeric, canaryOk === true and mechanismEngaged === true. Machine form: $defs.admittedRun. nAttempted counts every non-skipped run of the cell (attemptedRunIds), nAdmitted counts the admitted ones (sourceRunIds).
rules.measured: A row is `measured` iff its stage is objective (not design/plan, or it carries a non-null promotion) AND nAdmitted >= 3 AND nAdmitted * 3 >= nAttempted * 2; otherwise `triaged` with a triageReason. The SCHEMA enforces only: measured has triageReason null and nAdmitted >= 3, triaged has a triageReason string, and the judged-stage promotion coupling. The ratio, the iff itself and nAdmitted <= nAttempted are semantic predicates S1 and S2.
rules.judgedStages: Rows of the judged stages (design, plan) are written `triaged` with `JUDGED_UNPROMOTED` until promoted; a `measured` judged row must carry a non-null promotion.
rules.compatKey: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON (keys sorted at every depth, no whitespace) of {stage, archetypeVersion, fixtureDigest, oracleVersion}. Uplift is computed only within one compatKey and the champion must be `measured` in it, else uplift null with upliftNullReason NO_COMPATIBLE_CHAMPION. The row carrying the uplift (the source arm) must be `measured` too: a row that is not `measured` has uplift null with upliftNullReason SOURCE_NOT_MEASURED, which takes precedence when both arms fail (plan G4: null "when either arm is not measured"). upliftNullReason is therefore null iff uplift is non-null, else exactly one of SOURCE_NOT_MEASURED (source arm not measured) or NO_COMPATIBLE_CHAMPION (source measured, champion absent or not measured in the compatKey). Enforced by semantic predicates S4 (champion arm) and S8 (source arm and reason). A newer compatKey never mixes with an older one.
rules.cellKey: stage plus the resolved ingredients (provider, modelID, effort, workflow), joined with `|`, for example `debug|claude|claude-sonnet-5-5|standard|default`. Never a tier name alone.
rules.latest: latest[stage][compatKey][cellKey] = rowId of the newest `measured` row of that cell, newest by the INSTANT generatedAt denotes (parsed, offsets applied, full fractional precision; never string order, since date-time allows offsets). The index is complete: every distinct (stage, compatKey, cellKey) that has at least one `measured` row has an entry, including after a replacement or a demotion (a cell left with no measured row has no entry). A `prior` row is never in latest. Enforced by semantic predicates S5 and S6, not by the schema.
rules.prior: A `prior` row (fleet prior, P1) has its own closed shape, $defs.priorRow: rowId, stage, cellKey, ingredients (effort and workflow may be null = unknown), state "prior", vector (only accuracy is meaningful, a {median, min, max} of the first-pass CLEAN fraction; the other five are null), as_of and n exactly as P1 keeps them, generatedAt. ABSENT on a prior because there is no experiment behind it: compatKey, catalogDigest, fixtureId, fixtureDigest, archetypeVersion, oracleVersion, nAttempted, nAdmitted, triageReason, uplift, upliftNullReason, promotion, sourceRunIds, attemptedRunIds, experimentId. A prior row's cellKey writes `unknown` for a null effort or workflow. A prior may never be uplift input, a champion, in `latest`, or selectable by assembly (S4, S5).
rules.catalogRule: Assembly uses only rows whose catalogDigest equals the target digest, where the target is the explicit digest when one is named (--catalog-digest), else the current catalog's digest. A selected row that does not equal the target is refused with STALE_CATALOG. Enforced by semantic predicate S7, not by the schema.
rules.measurementDecisionOwnership: Written by M1; read by A1 and V1.
rules.validationBoundary: JSON Schema (Ajv 2020) checks SHAPE only. The rules in $.semantic[] need arithmetic or joins across rows, which JSON Schema cannot express, so they are NOT enforced by validating against $defs.registry. They are enforced by one function, validateRegistrySemantics(registry, {currentCatalogDigest, explicitCatalogDigest, selectedRowIds}) -> [{code, rowId}], which G4's registry writer (lib/experiment-registry.js) calls before every write of registry.json, A1 calls before it selects rows, and P1 calls over the prior rows it adds. An empty result is the only pass. $.semanticCases[] is its conformance suite (each case is a registry that is schema-valid, so only this layer can reject it).
rules.demoted: demoteRows(registry, {rowIds, reason: "JUDGE_DRIFT"}) sets state `triaged`, triageReason `JUDGE_DRIFT` and KEEPS the row's promotion object as the record of what was demoted (a judged triaged row with a null promotion must say JUDGED_UNPROMOTED, so a demoted row cannot have it null). Because uplift needs both arms measured (S4, S8), the same write sets the demoted row's uplift null with upliftNullReason SOURCE_NOT_MEASURED, sets uplift null with NO_COMPATIBLE_CHAMPION on every row whose uplift was computed against the demoted row (the writer may instead recompute it against a remaining measured row of the champion cell in the same compatKey), and updates latest per S6.
rules.emptySample: Statistics over an empty admitted set are null, never zeros: when nAdmitted is 0 every vector member is null (schema); when nAdmitted > 0 every member except usd is a {median, min, max} (schema). sourceRunIds lists the ADMITTED runs the vector was computed over; attemptedRunIds lists every non-skipped run of the cell (admitted or not). Both counts are checked by S3. accuracies lists those runs' accuracies in the same order (S10).
rules.uplift: Signed uplift of a source row over a champion row: delta of the median accuracy (source minus champion) with a seeded 95% percentile bootstrap, computed ONLY from persisted samples. Every experiment row stores `accuracies`, the admitted per-run accuracies parallel to `sourceRunIds` (same length and order, and they reproduce vector.accuracy exactly: S10), so an uplift can be recomputed after any row changes. The champion row is chosen deterministically: among `measured` rows with the source's stage and compatKey whose cellKey is the named champion cell, the row with the SAME catalogDigest as the source first (a source never reads another catalog's samples while its own catalog has a champion row), else the newest generatedAt by parsed instant, else the greater rowId (the tiebreak latest uses). The uplift records the exact bindings: championRowId, championSampleRevision and sourceSampleRevision, where a sample revision is the sha256 hex of the canonical JSON of that row's {sourceRunIds, accuracies}. S9 rejects an uplift whose championRowId is not the deterministic pick, or whose recorded revisions differ from the rows' current samples. A writer therefore recomputes (or nulls with SOURCE_NOT_MEASURED / NO_COMPATIBLE_CHAMPION) every uplift whenever a row is replaced, promoted or demoted, including a champion that arrives in a later call or is refreshed. A null uplift carries no champion cell, so it re-binds only when a write names the champion cell again.
rules.snapshot: Replacing a row (same rowId) is a COMPLETE cell snapshot: the new attemptedRunIds must contain every attemptedRunId the row already records, else the writer refuses with INCOMPLETE_SNAPSHOT and changes nothing. Failed and unadmitted runs stay in the snapshot (they count in nAttempted), so the caller (B1) supplies the whole cell, cached failures included. The replacement's runs, accuracies and statistics supersede the old ones; nothing is merged.

admittedRun.description: Partial schema of a stage run record (stage-run-contract.json $defs.stageRunExecuted): matches iff the run is admitted. A run with canaryOk false, mechanismEngaged false, an oracleError, null accuracy, an _error, a skipped marker or an incomplete outcome does NOT match.

spread.description: {median, min, max} over the admitted runs (never over an empty set: see rules.emptySample).

spreadOrNull.description: null = no statistic: usd when any admitted run had unknown cost, and every member when nAdmitted is 0.

championRowId.description: The exact champion row this uplift was computed against ($.rules.uplift picks it deterministically; S9).

championSampleRevision.description: sha256 hex of the canonical JSON of the champion row's {sourceRunIds, accuracies} when the uplift was computed (S9).

sourceSampleRevision.description: The same revision for the row that carries this uplift (S9).

promotionEvidence.description: Evidence accepted by promoteRows(registry, {rowIds, evidence}); also the shape stored in row.promotion.

measurementDecision.description: #measurementDecision (review r2 R2-3): written by M1, read by A1 and V1. `measured` carries no reason; `noSignal` carries one.

effort.description: Allowed resolved efforts, from lib/model-catalog.js:11 (the catalog's own list). resolveAgentConfig returns null effort for a tier with no thinking config (for example claude::budget); record that as "unavailable". A tier label such as "standard" is never an effort.

priorIngredients.description: Fleet-prior ingredients: provider and modelID are known, effort and workflow are null when the fleet data does not say.

priorVector.description: Only accuracy (the first-pass CLEAN fraction as {median: f, min: f, max: f}) is meaningful for a prior; the other members are null, never fabricated.

asOf.description: The as_of stamp of estimate.py output, kept verbatim (for example 2026-10-17T20:48).

upliftNullReason.description: null iff uplift is non-null; else SOURCE_NOT_MEASURED or NO_COMPATIBLE_CHAMPION ($.rules.compatKey, semantic S8).

sourceRunIds.description: The ADMITTED runs the vector was computed over (length nAdmitted, may be empty).

accuracies.description: The admitted per-run accuracies, parallel to sourceRunIds (same length and order; may be empty). The samples every uplift is computed from; they reproduce vector.accuracy exactly (S10).

attemptedRunIds.description: Every non-skipped run of the cell, admitted or not (length nAttempted).

experimentRow.description: A row written by an experiment (state triaged or measured). Prior rows are $defs.priorRow.

priorRow.description: state `prior`: a fleet prior (P1). See rules.prior for what is absent and why.

row.description: Any registry row: an experiment row (triaged | measured) or a prior row, discriminated by state.

promotion.description: #promotion: the entry point for promotion and demotion. Matches the evidence object (what J2 hands over and what row.promotion stores), the promoteRows(registry, {rowIds, evidence}) arguments, or the demoteRows(registry, {rowIds, reason}) arguments. The three shapes are disjoint. Consumers that need exactly one use #promotionEvidence, #promoteRowsArgs or #demoteRowsArgs.

semantic.statement: Let eligible = (stage is not design/plan OR promotion is non-null) AND nAdmitted >= 3 AND nAdmitted * 3 >= nAttempted * 2. Unless triageReason is INCOMPATIBLE or JUDGE_DRIFT (assigned by assembly and demoteRows): state === "measured" iff eligible, and a triaged row's triageReason is the first that applies of JUDGED_UNPROMOTED (judged stage, promotion null), LOW_N (nAdmitted < 3), LOW_ADMISSION (nAdmitted * 3 < nAttempted * 2).
attemptedRunIds.length === nAttempted, sourceRunIds.length === nAdmitted, sourceRunIds is a subset of attemptedRunIds, and neither list repeats an id.

Champion arm. A row with a non-null uplift names a champion: some row of the same registry has that cellKey, the SAME compatKey, and state `measured`. A prior or triaged row, or a row of another compatKey, is not a champion. The source arm (the row carrying the uplift) is S8.
No rowId in latest and no selected rowId names a `prior` row.

Pointers: every latest[stage][compatKey][cellKey] = rowId names an existing row whose stage, compatKey and cellKey are those keys, whose state is `measured`, and no measured row of that stage, compatKey and cellKey has a later generatedAt INSTANT (parse both timestamps, apply offsets, compare full fractional seconds; never compare the strings). Completeness: every distinct (stage, compatKey, cellKey) of a `measured` row has a latest entry (a missing entry is reported with the measured row's rowId).

target = explicitCatalogDigest if non-null else currentCatalogDigest. Every selected row is `measured` and has catalogDigest === target, else STALE_CATALOG. Naming the digest the rows carry therefore overrides a newer current catalog; naming any other digest does not.

Source arm and null reason (plan G4: uplift null with a reason when either arm is not measured). A row whose state is not `measured` has uplift === null and upliftNullReason === "SOURCE_NOT_MEASURED". A `measured` row with uplift === null has upliftNullReason === "NO_COMPATIBLE_CHAMPION". (A non-null uplift with a null reason is schema; its champion arm is S4.) Applies to triageReason INCOMPATIBLE and JUDGE_DRIFT rows too.

Binding. A row with a non-null uplift names its champion row: uplift.championRowId resolves to a row that is `measured`, with the source's stage and compatKey and cellKey === uplift.championCellKey, and it is the deterministic pick of $.rules.uplift (same catalogDigest first, then newest generatedAt by instant, then greater rowId) among the registry's rows; uplift.sourceSampleRevision equals the sha256 hex of the canonical JSON of the source row's {sourceRunIds, accuracies}, and uplift.championSampleRevision the same for the champion row. A replaced, promoted or demoted champion, or a changed sample, therefore leaves a stale uplift that this rejects.

accuracies has the length of sourceRunIds, every element is a finite number in [0, 1], and {median, min, max} of accuracies equals vector.accuracy exactly (an empty accuracies means vector.accuracy is null).

refProbes.description: $ref strings the plan and its consumers use; the oracle compiles each exactly. Each entry carries one instance that must match.
